_README: Config for the data-pipeline generator (issue #36) that produces programs.ts from program_index.json. exclude = poids kept OUT of the onboarding picker (structural / requirements-for-all; still ingested into program_map for the RAG). exclude_notes = human-readable name + rationale per excluded poid, rendered into the generated programs.ts header so the exclusions stay documented at the point of use. display_overrides = trimmed, student-friendly picker labels by poid; anything not listed falls back to the official catalog name. The generator sorts the final list by display label.
